about: app_restart quits a working FreeCAD cleanly and starts it again. Needs the person's go in chat (unproven-hub-model.json notCovered): it quits FreeCAD; documents not saved are reopened from their newest saved copies only. The runner sends these last, after every other model, one file at a time, waiting for the heartbeat (session_state answers) before the next.

calls.expect: saved: the documents that have a file; neverSaved lists the test documents (they are not wanted after the run)
restarting true; reopens lists the saved documents' files
answers once the window is back: where window; the reopened documents
